# gandi_domain_autorenew (Resource)

Manages the automatic renewal setting of a Gandi domain. Changing the setting is free; Gandi charges when it renews the domain. By default, deleting this resource stops Terraform managing the setting but leaves it as it is at Gandi (see `disable_on_destroy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gandi_domain_autorenew" "example" {
  domain   = "example.com"
  enabled  = true
  duration = 1 # years added at each renewal, 1–9

  # org_id           = "..."  # organization billed; Gandi's choice if unset
  # disable_on_destroy = true # turn renewal off when this resource is removed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain (FQDN) whose automatic renewal is managed.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Gandi renews the domain automatically before it expires.

### Optional

- `disable_on_destroy` (Boolean) Turn automatic renewal off when this resource is destroyed. Defaults to `false`, so removing the resource never lets a domain lapse by accident.
- `duration` (Number) Years added at each automatic renewal (1–9). Defaults to 1.
- `org_id` (String) UUID of the organization billed for automatic renewals. If unset, Gandi chooses it and the value it reports is kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain (FQDN); same as `domain`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Automatic renewal is imported by domain (FQDN).
terraform import gandi_domain_autorenew.example example.com
```
